question: What do we use when it is raining? 🌧️
explanation: Great job! An umbrella keeps us dry from the rain! 🌧️
hint: You hold it over your head to stay dry.

question: What do you like to eat in the hot summer? ☀️
explanation: Yay! Yummy cold ice cream is perfect for a hot summer day! ☀️
hint: It is cold, sweet, and melts fast!

question: How does the weather feel in summer? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Summer is the time when the sun shines bright and hot! 🌞
hint: You sweat a lot in this weather.

question: What clothes keep us cool in summer? 👕
explanation: Super star! Light cotton clothes help us feel nice and cool! 🌬️
hint: They are light and soft.

question: What gives us cool air inside the house? 🏠
explanation: Yay! A fan spins fast to give us lovely cool air! 🌬️
hint: It goes round and round on the ceiling.

question: Which sweet yellow fruit do we eat in summer? 🥭
explanation: Great job! Summer is the season for sweet and juicy mangoes! 🥭
hint: It is the king of fruits.

question: What do we drink when we feel very hot? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Cold water makes us feel so fresh on a hot day! 🚰
hint: You keep it in the fridge.

question: What do we wear on our eyes to block the bright sun? 😎
explanation: Super star! Sunglasses protect our beautiful eyes from the sun! ☀️
hint: They are dark glasses.

question: Where do children love to play in the summer? 🌊
explanation: Yay! Swimming in the cool water is the best summer fun! 💧
hint: It is full of blue water.

question: What big yellow shape shines bright in summer? 🌞
explanation: Great job! The big yellow sun makes the summer very warm! 🌻
hint: It comes out in the day.

question: How does the weather feel in winter? ❄️
explanation: Awesome! Winter brings chilly winds and very cold days! ⛄
hint: You shiver in this weather.

question: What do we wear to stay warm in winter? 🧥
explanation: Super star! A soft woolen sweater keeps our body cozy and warm! 🥰
hint: Your mother makes you wear it when it is cold.

question: What do we put on our head in the cold winter? 🧢
explanation: Yay! A woolen cap covers our ears and head from the cold wind! 🌬️
hint: It is made of soft wool.

question: What keeps us warm when we sleep in winter? 🛏️
explanation: Great job! We pull a thick blanket over us for a cozy sleep! 😴
hint: It is soft and covers your bed.

question: What healthy hot drink is good for winter nights? 🥛
explanation: Awesome! Yummy hot milk keeps our tummy and body warm! 🐄
hint: It is white and comes from a cow.

question: What do we wear on our hands in winter? ✋
explanation: Super star! Gloves keep our little fingers from freezing! ❄️
hint: They cover your hands.

question: What white thing falls from the sky in very cold places? 🌨️
explanation: Yay! Soft white snow falls from the sky in winter! ❄️
hint: You can build a funny man with it.

question: What do we sit near to get warm? 🔥
explanation: Great job! A bright fire gives us wonderful heat on cold nights! 🪵
hint: It is bright orange and very hot.

question: What do we wear on our feet to keep them warm? 🦶
explanation: Awesome! Woolen socks keep our toes toasty and warm! 🧦
hint: You wear them inside your shoes.

question: What hot food do we drink from a bowl in winter? 🥣
explanation: Super star! Hot soup is delicious and very healthy in winter! 😋
hint: It is made of boiled vegetables.

question: What falls from the dark clouds in the sky? 🌧️
explanation: Yay! Splash splash! The rain falls from the dark grey clouds! ☔
hint: It makes everything wet.

question: What do we wear to stay dry in the rain? 🧥
explanation: Great job! A raincoat does not let the water touch our clothes! 🌧️
hint: It is shiny and waterproof.

question: What special shoes do we wear in muddy rain? 👢
explanation: Awesome! Gumboots keep our feet completely dry in the puddles! 💦
hint: They are long rubber boots.

question: Which green animal loves to jump in the rain? 🐸
explanation: Super star! The happy frog jumps and says 'Ribbit ribbit' in the rain! 🌧️
hint: It hops and lives near water.

question: What do children make with paper on a rainy day? ⛵
explanation: Yay! Floating a paper boat in the water is so much fun! 🌊
hint: It floats on the water puddles.

question: What covers the blue sky before it starts raining? ☁️
explanation: Great job! Dark grey clouds bring the fresh rain to us! ⛈️
hint: They hide the sun.

question: What beautiful arc of colours do we see after rain? 🌈
explanation: Awesome! A rainbow has seven beautiful colours shining in the sky! ✨
hint: It looks like a colourful bridge.

question: Which beautiful bird opens its feathers and dances in the rain? 🦚
explanation: Super star! The peacock looks beautiful when it dances in the rain! 🌧️
hint: It has colourful green and blue feathers.

question: What do children love to splash in during rain? 💦
explanation: Yay! Jumping in muddy water puddles is a fun rainy game! 👢
hint: It is a small pool of rainwater on the ground.

question: Which slow little animal comes out in the wet rain? 🐌
explanation: Great job! Snails love the wet weather and carry their home on their back! 🌧️
hint: It crawls very slowly with a shell.

question: What beautiful season comes after cold winter? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! Spring is a lovely season with perfect weather! 🌤️
hint: It is when flowers bloom.

question: What opens up and looks pretty in the spring season? 🌺
explanation: Super star! Colourful flowers bloom everywhere in spring! 🌷
hint: They grow in gardens and smell sweet.

question: Who flies around the pretty flowers in spring? 🦋
explanation: Yay! Butterflies have colourful wings and love the spring flowers! ✨
hint: It starts as a caterpillar.

question: How is the weather in the spring season? 🌤️
explanation: Great job! Spring is not too hot and not too cold, it is just right! 🌈
hint: It is pleasant and happy.

question: What do the happy birds do in spring? 🐦
explanation: Awesome! The birds chirp and sing sweet songs in the trees! 🌳
hint: They make sweet music with their beak.

question: What new things grow on the tree branches in spring? 🌳
explanation: Super star! The trees look so fresh with baby green leaves! 🌱
hint: They are green and soft.

question: Which insect makes a 'buzz' sound near the flowers? 🐝
explanation: Yay! The busy bee collects nectar to make sweet honey! 🍯
hint: It is yellow and black.

question: What colours do we see in a spring garden? 🎨
explanation: Great job! The blooming flowers fill the garden with a rainbow of colours! 🌸
hint: Red, pink, yellow, blue, everything!

question: How do the trees look in the spring season? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! All the trees wake up and wear beautiful green leaves! 🌲
hint: They are full of life.

question: What is the best thing to do in spring? 🏞️
explanation: Super star! The nice weather makes playing in the park so much fun! 🎈
hint: You go out with your friends.

question: How many main seasons are there in a year? 🌍
explanation: Yay! We enjoy four wonderful seasons all year round! 🌞
hint: Count: Summer, Winter, Monsoon, Spring.

question: Which season makes you want to sit under a fan? 🪕
explanation: Great job! The fan keeps us cool during the hot summer! 🥵
hint: It is the hottest season.

question: Which season makes you want to sit near a fire? 🔥
explanation: Awesome! The bright fire warms us up in the cold winter! 🥶
hint: It is the coldest season.

question: Which season makes you open your umbrella? ☂️
explanation: Super star! We use our umbrella in the wet monsoon season! ☔
hint: Water falls from the sky.

question: Which season brings a garden full of fresh flowers? 🌷
explanation: Yay! Spring is the happy season of blooming flowers and green leaves! 🌼
hint: The butterflies love this season.

question: Which big juicy green and red fruit do we eat in summer? 🍉
explanation: Great job! Sweet watermelon is full of cool water for hot days! 💧
hint: It has little black seeds.

question: What do we wrap around our neck in winter? 🧣
explanation: Awesome! A woolen muffler keeps our neck snug and warm! 🥰
hint: It is long and made of wool.

question: Where does the rain fall down loudly? 🏠
explanation: Super star! We hear the rain going pitter-patter on the roof! 🌧️
hint: It is the top part of your house.

question: What do we fly in the nice spring breeze? 🪁
explanation: Yay! Flying a colourful kite in the spring breeze is magical! ✨
hint: It is tied to a string.

question: How do we feel playing in every season? 😊
explanation: Great job! Every season brings new games and makes us very happy! 🎉
hint: You smile a lot.
